_comment: Detachment-rule citations. Many of our Detachment flags are LOSSY approximations of the real 10e rule (per the dataclass docstring in code/detachments.py). The rule_name and quoted_text are verbatim from Wahapedia; the trigger and effect describe what the simulator actually implements, and are tagged 'approximation: true' where the simulator's behaviour diverges from the canonical rule. 5 fabricated detachments (CULT_OF_MAGIC, PLAGUE_COMPANY, PLAGUE_MARINES_ONSLAUGHT, SAIM_HANN_WILD_HOST, WAAAGH_DETACHMENT) and their citations were deleted in commit e4b057f per the fabrication audit.

AWAKENED_DYNASTY.reanimate_per_round.quoted_text: If your Warlord is a NECRONS model, then at the end of each of your Command phases, each unit from your army with this ability that has had one or more destroyed bodyguard models can use this ability. If it does, restore one destroyed bodyguard model in that unit to your army (with its full wounds remaining).
AWAKENED_DYNASTY.reanimate_per_round.trigger: end of each round, for every friendly Necrons unit that lost at least one model THIS round (gated by a round-start alive-count snapshot — Fix F-NEC-1, iter 2)
AWAKENED_DYNASTY.reanimate_per_round.effect: restore 1 destroyed model per profile per round at full wounds, anchored on a living peer. APPROXIMATION: real rule is verbatim 'one destroyed bodyguard model' per unit; we group identical profiles together as a unit. See simulator.reanimation_protocols citation for full implementation notes.

SHIELD_HOST.melee_ap_plus_one.quoted_text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ADEPTUS CUSTODES models from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability by 1.
SHIELD_HOST.melee_ap_plus_one.trigger: Adeptus Custodes melee attacker in an army with the Shield Host detachment, on ODD battle rounds (1, 3, 5). The player picks one Ka'tah stance at the start of each battle round; Rendax Ka'tah is modelled as the ODD-round pick. CUSTODES-KATAH-V1 (claude/sim-calibration-6): the fabricated Crit-on-5+ EVEN-round bullet removed; only this Rendax AP+1 ODD-round bullet remains active.
SHIELD_HOST.melee_ap_plus_one.effect: melee Armour Penetration improved by 1 (e.g. AP 0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2). Encoded as ap = ap - 1 in Unit.attack. Fires only on ODD battle rounds (1, 3, 5) — gated by _battle_ref._current_round % 2 == 1.

_ANNIHILATION_LEGION.annihilation_protoc.quoted_text: Each time a DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army declares a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll. If one or more targets of that charge are Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Charge roll as well. Each time a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack.
_ANNIHILATION_LEGION.annihilation_protoc.trigger: DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit declaring a charge (charge re-roll leg); DESTROYER CULT unit making a ranged attack targeting the closest eligible target (+1 Armour Penetration leg)
_ANNIHILATION_LEGION.annihilation_protoc.effect: UNMODELLED — both legs require new simulator machinery not yet present. Charge re-roll leg: the Detachment dataclass has no charge-reroll field and _do_charge has no detachment-supplied re-roll hook. Plus-one Armour Penetration leg: Unit.attack has no 'is closest eligible target' predicate. The fabricated 'Hardened Killers' rule and its reroll_wound_ones=True flag were removed in wave 235 as they corresponded to no real codex rule. The detachment remains registered as a no-buff variety pick.

INQUISITION_TASK_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones.quoted_text: Each time an INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and, if the target of that attack is a DAEMON unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.
INQUISITION_TASK_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones.trigger: any friendly Imperial Agents hit roll
INQUISITION_TASK_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones.effect: re-roll hit rolls of 1 (approximation of the Ordo Malleus 'Destroy the Daemonic' rule, applied army-wide rather than gated to Inquisitor/Inquisitorial Agents/Ordo Malleus keywords; codex has no umbrella 'Inquisition Task Force' detachment, so we cite the closest-themed Ordo detachment)

TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones.quoted_text: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones.trigger: any friendly Grey Knights hit roll
TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones.effect: re-roll hit rolls of 1 (approximation of the Fury of Titan deep-strike-turn gated buff, applied army-wide always-on; the wound-1 half is wired separately as TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_wound_ones). Restored in SC5-6 — the cited quoted_text already covered the hit-1 half but only the wound-1 flag was wired on the detachment. FIDELITY GATE SWEG_GK_FURY_FAITHFUL (default off, detachment flag reroll_ones_requires_deep_strike): restores the codex deep-strike-turn gate — the reroll applies only to a unit that arrived from reserves this round (_fresh_arrivals proxy). A/B (Grey Knights-scoped N=80 into sc12a): Grey Knights 55.7 -> 46.2 (paired -9.48), headline 5.78 -> 5.66; built-and-held.

TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_wound_ones.quoted_text: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_wound_ones.trigger: any friendly Grey Knights wound roll
TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_wound_ones.effect: re-roll wound rolls of 1 (approximation of the Fury of Titan deep-strike-turn gated buff, applied army-wide always-on; the hit-1 half is wired separately as TELEPORT_STRIKE_FORCE.reroll_hit_ones). Gated to the codex deep-strike-turn window under SWEG_GK_FURY_FAITHFUL (see the reroll_hit_ones entry).

WARHOST.martial_grace.quoted_text: At the start of the battle round, you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token. Each time a unit from your army performs the Swift as the Wind Agile Manoeuvre, until the end of the phase, add an additional 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit. Each time a unit from your army performs an Agile Manoeuvre that involves rolling a D6, add 1 to the result.
WARHOST.martial_grace.trigger: start of each battle round, while the Warhost detachment is active and the army contains at least one ASURYANI unit
WARHOST.martial_grace.effect: +1 Battle Focus token at the start of each battle round, stacking on top of the battle-size base grant in Battle._grant_battle_focus_tokens (wave 235: corrected from a single +1 to the starting pool to a per-round +1, matching the verbatim 'at the start of the battle round' trigger). The Swift-as-the-Wind +1" Move leg and the +1-to-D6 Agile-Manoeuvre boon are NOT MODELLED — the movement model has no per-phase +1" / +1-to-d6 infrastructure for Agile Manoeuvres other than Star Engines; these two legs remain queued as unmodelled Agile Manoeuvre work.

MONTKA.army_wide_assault_rounds_1_3.quoted_text: During the first, second and third battle rounds, ranged weapons equipped by T'AU EMPIRE models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.
MONTKA.army_wide_assault_rounds_1_3.trigger: any friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit attempting to shoot in battle rounds 1-3 after Advancing
MONTKA.army_wide_assault_rounds_1_3.effect: ranged weapons gain the [ASSAULT] keyword for battle rounds 1-3 — simulator reads the flag in _do_shoot to exempt T'au attackers from the Advance-then-no-shoot lockout during the window (free, no Battle Focus token spend). Cited as MONTKA.army_wide_assault_rounds_1_3

MONTKA.lethal_hits_on_guided.rule_name: Killing Blow (Mont'ka, [LETHAL HITS] on Guided half)
MONTKA.lethal_hits_on_guided.quoted_text: During the first, second and third battle rounds, while a unit is a Guided unit, its ranged weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
MONTKA.lethal_hits_on_guided.trigger: any friendly T'AU EMPIRE Guided unit's ranged attack
MONTKA.lethal_hits_on_guided.effect: ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] (Crit Hit auto-wounds) ONLY in battle rounds 1-3. Read by Unit.attack via Army.guided_enemy_uids (populated each round by Battle._run_markerlight_phase from alive MARKERLIGHT-keyword units in the T'au army). T-AU-DIAG-2 (2026-05-23): added the rounds 1-3 gate to match the verbatim quoted_text. The prior implementation applied LETHAL HITS army-wide every round (justified as an alleged Markerlight base-rule effect), but the verbatim Wahapedia Mont'ka text is explicit: this LETHAL HITS keyword interaction is the Killing Blow detachment effect, sharing the same rounds 1-3 window as the [ASSAULT] half. The Guided / Marked status itself is still granted every round by the underlying Markerlight army rule (see `simulator.markerlights`) — only the LETHAL HITS keyword grant is round-gated.

RUBRICAE_PHALANX.all_is_dust.rule_name: All Is Dust (Rubricae Phalanx Detachment Rule)
RUBRICAE_PHALANX.all_is_dust.quoted_text: Each time an attack with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to a RUBRICAE model from your army, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.
RUBRICAE_PHALANX.all_is_dust.trigger: the defender carries the RUBRICAE unit-keyword AND the incoming attack's per_shot_dmg == 1.0 AND the defender's army resolves to a detachment with `all_is_dust=True` (Rubricae Phalanx)
RUBRICAE_PHALANX.all_is_dust.effect: +1 to the defender's armour saving throw at the save-modifier layer, capped at 2+. iter15 makes this the canonical detachment for TSON (DEFAULT_BY_FACTION['Thousand Sons'] = 'rubricae_phalanx'); Grand Coven retained as opt-in for psyker-heavy lists. The simulator-side gate lives in `Unit.attack` and reads `target.army_ref.resolve_detachment().all_is_dust`. Companion citation `simulator.all_is_dust` covers the Unit.attack call-site. Verbatim 'unmodified Damage characteristic of 1' wording cross-checked against 40k.app + Goonhammer + Frontline Gaming Rubricae Phalanx breakdowns (WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time).

HALLOWED_MARTYRS.soror_blood_of_martyrs.quoted_text: Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model's unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll, as well, if that model's unit is Below Half-strength.
HALLOWED_MARTYRS.soror_blood_of_martyrs.trigger: attacker faction is Adepta Sororitas AND the army's resolved detachment carries soror_blood_of_martyrs=True (Hallowed Martyrs detachment); below Starting Strength = alive squad members < starting count (single-model unit: current wounds < starting wounds); below Half-strength = alive members < starting count divided by 2 (single-model: current wounds < starting wounds divided by 2); applies to both ranged and melee attacks
HALLOWED_MARTYRS.soror_blood_of_martyrs.effect: +1 to the Hit roll when below Starting Strength (routes through the 10e plus-or-minus-1 hit-modifier clamp); additionally +1 to the Wound roll when below Half-strength (routes through the 10e plus-or-minus-1 wound-modifier clamp). Verbatim rule text taken from BSData v10.6.0 cache (Imperium - Adepta Sororitas.cat.gz, rule id afa4-169c-3aaa-650) per CLAUDE.md rule 6; Wahapedia URL recorded for human verification. Gate implemented in Unit.attack via squad alive count vs _battle_ref._squad_start_count[(army.name, squad_id)] for multi-model squads and wound fraction for single-model units (mirrors the Delirium / battleshock single-model convention in simulator.py). wave 234 (2026-06-10).

BRINGERS_OF_FLAME.army_wide_assault.quoted_text: Ranged weapons equipped by ADEPTA SORORITAS models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time an attack made with such a weapon targets a unit within 6", add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
BRINGERS_OF_FLAME.army_wide_assault.trigger: any Adepta Sororitas unit in a Bringers of Flame army that Advanced in the current round and then attempts to shoot; no round gate, no token spend; the flag army_wide_assault=True on the resolved Detachment enables the window in simulator._do_shoot. Gated SWEG_BOF_ASSAULT (default ON since wave 240, adopted on a decisive Sororitas-scoped N=80 paired measurement; SWEG_BOF_ASSAULT=0 restores the legacy no-[ASSAULT] path). BSData v10.6.0 source (Imperium - Adepta Sororitas.cat.gz) corroborates the Wahapedia text verbatim.
BRINGERS_OF_FLAME.army_wide_assault.effect: simulator._do_shoot skips the Advance-then-no-shoot lockout for the attacker — mirrors the [ASSAULT] keyword grant on all Adepta Sororitas ranged weapons. Only the [ASSAULT] leg is modelled; the Strength+1 within 6 inches leg is a held follow-up requiring per-target range geometry in Unit.attack.
